text: Mutumin Katsina “Bakatsine” ne, mutanen Katsina kuma “Katsinawa”. Me ake kiran mutanen Kano?
gloss: A man of Katsina is “Bakatsine”, the people of Katsina “Katsinawa”. What are the people of Kano called? — Kanawa: the -awa plural of origin. Bakane is one Kano man; Kanuri and Kanembu are other peoples.

text: Ka sa ƙugiya a k ɗin “baki”, wato bakin mutum, sai ka samu sunan wani launi. Wane launi ne?
gloss: Put a hook on the k of “baki” (mouth) and you get the name of a colour. Which? — Black (baƙi): k and hooked ƙ are different letters in Hausa.

text: Idan aka ce maka “ƙarfe huɗu saura kwata”, wane lokaci ne?
gloss: If you are told “four o’clock less a quarter”, what time is it? — 3:45: “saura” means “remaining”, a quarter still left until four.

text: Ketchup, jan miya mai kauri da ake ci da soyayyen dankali, da me aka fi yin sa?
gloss: Ketchup, the thick red sauce eaten with chips — what is it mostly made of? — Tomatoes. Red bell pepper (tattasai) is the look-alike trap.

text: Daddawa ta gargajiya, wadda ake sa wa miya don ƙamshi, da ƙwayar wace bishiya ake yin ta?
gloss: Traditional daddawa, the seasoning that gives soup its aroma — from the seeds of which tree? — Ɗorawa (African locust bean, Parkia biglobosa), fermented. Baobab, tamarind and shea are the others.

text: A auren Musulunci, wane abu ne shari'a ta wajabta ango ya bai wa amarya?
gloss: In an Islamic marriage, what does the law make obligatory for the groom to give the bride? — Sadaki (mahr). Lefe (the gift box) is customary; gara and kayan ɗaki come from the bride’s side.

text: A ƙasar Hausa, a rana ta nawa bayan haihuwa ake yin bikin raɗin suna?
gloss: In Hausaland, on which day after birth is the naming ceremony held? — The seventh day.

text: A ƙwallon ƙafa, idan ƙwallo ta fita ta layin gefen fili, ta yaya ake dawo da ita wasa?
gloss: In football, when the ball goes out over the touchline, how is it brought back into play? — A throw-in with the hands. Corner, penalty and free kick are the other restarts.

text: A WhatsApp, idan alamun ✓✓ da ke ƙarƙashin saƙonka suka koma shuɗi, me hakan yake nufi?
gloss: On WhatsApp, when the two ticks under your message turn blue, what does it mean? — It has been read. Two grey ticks mean delivered.

text: Idan aka zuba man gyaɗa a cikin ruwa aka ɗan jira, me zai faru?
options: Za su gauraye su zama ɗaya
Man zai taru a saman ruwan
gloss: Pour groundnut oil into water and wait a little: what happens? — The oil gathers on top: it is lighter than water and does not mix with it.

text: Kaza tana kwanciya a kan ƙwayayenta kusan mako nawa kafin 'yan tsaki su fito?
gloss: For about how many weeks does a hen sit on her eggs before the chicks hatch? — About 3 weeks (21 days).

text: Birnin Dubai, inda 'yan kasuwa da yawa daga Kano suke zuwa sayayya, yana wace ƙasa?
gloss: Dubai, where many Kano traders go to buy goods, is in which country? — The United Arab Emirates.

text: Najeriya da Nijar duk sun sami 'yancin kai a shekara ɗaya. Wace shekara ce?
gloss: Nigeria and Niger both became independent in the same year. Which? — 1960 (Niger on 3 August, Nigeria on 1 October). 1957 is Ghana; 1963 is when Nigeria became a republic.

text: Wane littafi ne Allah ya saukar wa Annabi Dauda?
gloss: Which scripture did God reveal to the Prophet David? — The Psalms (Zabura). Torah to Moses, Gospel to Jesus, Qur’an to Muhammad.

text: Wane kayan kiɗan Hausa ne ake matsewa a hamata, har sautinsa yana hawa yana sauka kamar mutum yana magana?
gloss: Which Hausa instrument is squeezed under the arm so that its pitch rises and falls like speech? — Kalangu, the hourglass “talking drum”. Goge is a fiddle, kakaki a long trumpet, garaya a lute.

text: Shirin “Squid Game”, wanda ya yi fice a Netflix har duniya ta san shi, daga wace ƙasa ya fito?
gloss: The series “Squid Game”, a worldwide Netflix hit — which country is it from? — South Korea. Japan, home of anime and similar survival-game stories, is the trap.

text: Mai tatsuniya ya ce: “Ga ta nan, ga ta nanku!” Me masu sauraro suke amsawa?
gloss: The storyteller says: “Here it is, here it is for you!” What do the listeners answer? — “Let it come so we may hear it.” “Kurunkus” is the formula that ends a tale, the trap.

text: Abubuwan sha irin su espresso da cappuccino da ake sayarwa a otal-otal da shagunan zamani, da me ake yin su?
gloss: Drinks like espresso and cappuccino sold in modern cafés — what are they made from? — Coffee. Cocoa (koko) and tea are the traps.

text: Kare yakan fitar da harshe yana haki idan rana ta yi zafi. Me hakan yake yi masa?
gloss: A dog sticks out its tongue and pants when it is hot. What does that do for it? — It cools the body: dogs barely sweat, so they lose heat by evaporation from the tongue and mouth.

text: Me ya sa nama ko madara ba sa saurin ɓaci idan suna cikin firji?
options: Duhun ciki yana hana su ruɓewa
Sanyi yana rage saurin ƙwayoyin cuta
gloss: Why do meat and milk not spoil quickly in a fridge? — Cold slows the growth of bacteria.

text: Hedkwatar daular da Shehu Usman ɗan Fodio ya kafa, inda Sarkin Musulmi yake zaune har yau, wane birni ne?
gloss: The headquarters of the caliphate founded by Shehu Usman ɗan Fodio, where the Sultan still sits — which city? — Sokoto. Gwandu was the seat of the western half under Abdullahi, the trap.

text: A ginin gargajiya, ana cuɗa laka a yi ƙananan dunƙule masu tsini, a busar da su a rana. Me ake kiransu?
gloss: In traditional building, mud is kneaded into small pointed lumps dried in the sun. What are they called? — Tubali, the conical mud bricks. Bulo is a cement block, kwano a zinc roofing sheet, siminti cement.

text: Idan aka haifi tagwaye maza a ƙasar Hausa, waɗanne sunaye aka fi raɗa musu?
gloss: When boy twins are born in Hausaland, what names are they most often given? — Hassan and Husaini (girls: Hassana and Husaina), after the Prophet’s two grandsons.

text: Za ka sayi data a waya. Wane kunshi ne ya fi girma?
gloss: You are buying phone data. Which bundle is biggest? — 1 GB: a gigabyte is about 1,000 megabytes, so it beats 900 MB.

text: Takalmi ne kuɗinsa ₦8,000, sai aka ce an yi rangwamen rabin farashi. Nawa za ka biya?
gloss: A pair of shoes costs ₦8,000 and is marked half price. How much do you pay? — ₦4,000: half of 8,000.

text: Ƙananan hotunan fuska kamar 😂 da ❤️ da ake sakawa a cikin saƙo, me ake kiransu?
gloss: The little face pictures like 😂 and ❤️ put into messages — what are they called? — Emoji.

text: A ƙwallon ƙafa, idan alƙalin wasa ya ce za a duba “VAR”, me ake dubawa?
gloss: In football, when the referee says he will check “VAR”, what is checked? — Video of the incident (Video Assistant Referee).

text: Ƙaramin katin da ake sakawa a cikin waya don ta samu layin kamfanin sadarwa, me ake kiransa?
gloss: The small card put into a phone so it gets a network line — what is it called? — The SIM card. A memory card stores files; katin caji is airtime.

text: A wane gari ne Kogin Kwara da Kogin Binuwai suke haɗuwa?
gloss: In which town do the Niger and Benue rivers meet? — Lokoja (Kogi State). Makurdi is on the Benue, Jebba and Onitsha on the Niger.

text: Wane kamfani ne ya mallaki Facebook, Instagram da WhatsApp?
gloss: Which company owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp? — Meta (renamed from Facebook, Inc. in 2021).

text: Wane fitaccen mawaƙin baka na Hausa ne, ɗan asalin jihar Katsina, ya rasu a 1999?
gloss: Which famous Hausa oral singer, from Katsina State, died in 1999? — Mamman Shata (1923–1999). Ɗanƙwairo died in 1991, Narambaɗa in 1960, Ɗan Maraya Jos in 2015.

text: A ƙwallon kwando, maki nawa ake samu idan aka jefa ƙwallo ta shiga raga daga bayan babban layin da'ira?
gloss: In basketball, how many points for a basket from beyond the big arc? — 3 points (the three-point line).

text: Sallar Juma'a tana maye gurbin wace salla daga cikin salloli biyar na ranar?
gloss: The Friday prayer takes the place of which of the day’s five prayers? — Zuhr (Azahar), the midday prayer.

text: Sunayen kwanaki sun zo daga Larabci: “Lahadi” na nufin ta ɗaya, “Litinin” ta biyu. To, “Alhamis” ta nawa ce?
gloss: Hausa weekday names come from Arabic: Lahadi means “the first”, Litinin “the second”. Which is Alhamis? — The fifth: count on Talata (3), Laraba (4), Alhamis (5).

text: Ƙungiyoyi huɗu za su fafata, kowace da kowace sau ɗaya kacal. Wasa nawa za a buga gaba ɗaya?
gloss: Four teams each play every other team exactly once. How many matches in all? — 6: 3 + 2 + 1. 12 is the home-and-away trap.

text: Littafin “Magana Jari Ce”, wanda wani aku yake ba da labarai a cikinsa, wane ne ya rubuta shi?
gloss: The book “Magana Jari Ce”, in which a parrot tells the stories, was written by whom? — Abubakar Imam (1930s).

text: Kalandar Hijira ta fara ne daga lokacin da Annabi Muhammadu ya yi hijira daga Makka zuwa wane birni?
gloss: The Hijri calendar begins with the Prophet Muhammad’s emigration from Mecca to which city? — Medina (622).

text: Tafkin Chadi yana taɓa iyakokin ƙasashe nawa?
gloss: Lake Chad touches the borders of how many countries? — 4: Nigeria, Niger, Chad and Cameroon.

text: Najeriya da Ghana suna cikin manyan masu noman ƙwayar da ake yin cakulan da ita. Wace ƙwaya ce?
gloss: Nigeria and Ghana are among the big growers of the bean chocolate is made from. Which? — Cocoa (koko). Kola nut (goro) is the local trap.

text: Hoton wace mace ce, shahararriyar mai sana'ar tukwane, yake jikin takardar Naira 20?
gloss: Whose portrait, a famous potter, is on the ₦20 note? — Ladi Kwali, the potter from Kwali.

text: Ƙwai yana nutsewa a ruwa, amma yakan yi yawo idan an narkar da gishiri da yawa a ciki. Me ya sa?
gloss: An egg sinks in water but floats once plenty of salt is dissolved in it. Why? — Salt water is denser (heavier per volume) than the egg.

text: Wane jarumin barkwanci na Kannywood ne aka fi sani da “Ɗan Ibro”?
gloss: Which Kannywood comic actor was best known as “Ɗan Ibro”? — Rabilu Musa (died 2014).

text: Wace Baturiya ce ta fara raɗa wa ƙasar sunan “Nigeria” a wata maƙala a 1897?
gloss: Which British woman first coined the name “Nigeria” in an 1897 article? — Flora Shaw (later Lady Lugard), in The Times.

text: Wane rukunin jini ne ake iya ƙara wa kusan kowane mara lafiya, shi ya sa ake kiransa “mai ba kowa”?
gloss: Which blood group can be given to almost any patient, the “universal donor”? — O negative. AB+ is the universal recipient, the trap.

text: Me ya sa kunnuwa sukan toshe idan jirgin sama yana sauka?
gloss: Why do your ears block when a plane is landing? — The change in air pressure: the cabin pressure rises faster than the middle ear can equalise; swallowing or yawning opens the Eustachian tube.

text: Daga “noma” Hausa ta samu “manomi”. Daga wace kalma ce aka samu “masunci”?
gloss: From “noma” (farming) Hausa makes “manomi” (farmer). From which word does “masunci” (fisherman) come? — Su, the Hausa word for fishing. Kifi (fish) is the trap.

text: Wane ne babban jarumin littafin “Things Fall Apart” na Chinua Achebe?
gloss: Who is the hero of Chinua Achebe’s “Things Fall Apart”? — Okonkwo. Obierika is his friend, Ikemefuna the boy he takes in, Ezeulu the hero of “Arrow of God”.

text: A ma'aunin Celsius, digiri nawa ne mafi ƙarancin sanyin da zai iya kasancewa, wato sifili na Kelvin?
gloss: On the Celsius scale, what is the lowest possible temperature, absolute zero? — About −273 °C (−273.15). −460 is roughly its Fahrenheit value, the trap.

text: Ƙahonin ado da ake ɗagawa a kusurwoyin saman bangon gidajen laka na Hausa, me ake kiransu?
gloss: The decorative horns raised at the top corners of Hausa mud walls — what are they called? — Zanko. Soro is a flat-roofed room, zaure the entrance hall, kyauro a reed.

text: Chappal Waddi, kololuwa mafi tsawo a Najeriya, tana wace jiha?
gloss: Chappal Waddi, Nigeria’s highest peak, is in which state? — Taraba (on the Cameroon border). Plateau and Adamawa, both highland states, are the traps.
